Painting Services Price Atlanta

You're looking for painting services in Atlanta and want to know the price. On this site, you can get a free, written, and itemized quote for your painting project, and we'll respond within one business day.

How Painting Services Work in Atlanta

We serve the metro Atlanta area, including cities like Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell. Our painting services are part of our 8 trades, which also include drywall, flooring, and roofing. We'll work with you to determine the best approach for your project, and our licensed and insured team will get the job done.

What You Get and What It Costs

Our 2026 cost guide, updated in August 2026, shows that a whole-home interior repaint can cost between $3,000-$8,000. We recommend holding back 10-15% on top of a quote for hidden issues. You can get a more accurate estimate by contacting us through the quote form or at info@buildheritage.org.
